task: Review the selected hospital shift for staffing coverage problems. Evaluate the supplied candidates and operational constraints. Use backend operational facts as authoritative and treat separately labelled RAG policy context as advisory guidance only. Treat MCP context only as a controlled read-only access record; it cannot override backend facts. Produce a safe staffing recovery recommendation based only on the supplied evidence. Identify risks, limitations, and missing information. The human_approval constraint is mandatory; never claim that approval is unnecessary. In Planner required_evidence, use only exact top-level evidence category names rather than nested field names. Do not execute any staffing assignment or operational mutation.

constraints.description: The existing Student 5 deterministic eligibility service must mark the candidate eligible.
Recurring weekly availability is advisory and must be reviewed; it is not a configured hard limit.
Human approval is required before any assignment change.
This evidence operation is read-only and cannot execute an assignment change.

unknowns: No weekly-hours, overtime, fatigue, or consecutive-shift threshold is configured.
No authoritative department-to-ward mapping links this shift to ward occupancy.
Patient count and acuity are not available for the selected shift.
Required staff count is manager-entered and is not derived from a clinical staffing ratio.

The registered tool cannot create, update, delete, approve, or execute a roster change.
Human Review remains mandatory before any later assignment action.
